## Rate limits (429)
- The provider's `Retry-After` delay is now kept for OpenAI, xAI and Anthropic. In 0.2.9 it was lost for most 429 errors, and capped at 5 minutes when it did arrive.
- The agent now waits at least as long as the provider asks. If the provider asks for more than 1 hour, the turn stops with the provider's message instead of retrying.
- Other providers (Google, OpenRouter, Kimi, Mistral) do not send a delay to the agent yet: they keep the 5 s to 5 min wait.

## Updates
- The update dialog now shows these release notes. In 0.2.8 and 0.2.9 the notes were empty in the update file.

## RLM chat
- The learning buttons at the top of the RLM chat no longer spill over their neighbours. In a narrow column they show icons only.

## Known limits
- Not checked by hand in the app yet: a real 429, the update dialog, and the narrow header.
